recentItems.title: Walks with Chris - Croxteth Park - Liverpool (February 28th 2026)
recentItems.description:
Discover Liverpool's very own Croxteth Hall and Country Park! In this travel guide video, I take you on a short tour of the park, which has so many footpaths and walks to choose from.  Many visitors don't realize how many different paths there are!

What we explore in this guide:
We walk from the main car park and walk along a footpath before coming back towards Croxteth Hall.
 
If you're planning a trip to Merseyside or looking for things to do in Liverpool, this guide will help you make the most of your visit and help you plan something away from the busy city centre.

Thanks for watching, Chris

#croxtethpark #liverpool #merseyside #walk #walking
